title: Turkish Kunefe with Fenugreek and Yellow Cheese
description: A traditional Turkish dessert made with kunefe pastry, fenugreek, and yellowed cheese, topped with a sweet syrup.

ingredients.name: kunefe pastry
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: fenugreek
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice flavor

instructions: Cut the kunefe pastry into 1-inch squares and place on a baking sheet.
Mix the crumbled cheese, ground fenugreek, and sugar in a bowl.
Brush the butter on the kunefe pastry.
Place a spoonful of the cheese mixture on each piece of pastry.
Fold the pastry in half to enclose the filling.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the pastry is baking, mix the water and lemon juice in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the pastry from the oven and brush with the sweet syrup.
Serve warm, topped with additional syrup if desired.
